newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Great Lakes REIT begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Great Lakes REIT begun.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Great Lakes REIT Inc with an outperform rating for both the intermediate and long term.
-- Funds from operations estimates for the suburban office property real estate investment trust, which went public in May, are $1.46 a share in 1997 and $1.64 a share in 1998, EVEREN said.
-- Intermediate price target is $19 and long-term is $21, EVEREN said. Great Lakes shares were down 1/8 at 16-3/4 Tuesday.

-- The strategy of the company, which focuses on Midwestern markets, "takes advantage of its own market expertise and reputation as a regional sharpshooter, stable and economically diverse markets, management's ability to add value at the property level, limited competition and the upside potential associated with its portfolio and existing markets," analyst Philip Martin wrote in a research note.
